blocks.text: ATLANTA— The Atlanta Dream’s shooters finally found some daylight. And as a result, the Dream’s goal of winning their first WNBA championship is still shining bright. Allisha Gray scored 23 points and Rhyne Howard had 21 as the hot-shooting Dream held off Golden State’s late rally to take an 80-69 victory over the Valkyries in Game 6 on Thursday and pull even in the WNBA Finals. READ: WNBA: Kiah Stokes leads Valkyries past Dream, closer to title The decisive Game 7 will be played at Golden State on Saturday night as each team seeks its first WNBA championship.
